summary: Reproduced the 41 'Missing context file' failures and root-caused them: all 41 come from the .opencode arm of a --all run, where the files genuinely do not exist (0 of 41 resolve), while --claude alone is green. The defect is not path resolution but unattributed reporting (the FAIL line omits the system tree and resolved path) plus a real data inconsistency in the committed .opencode/context/index.json, which lists 41 memory/nix/nvim entries never mirrored into that tree. The 4-phase plan fixes the message attribution, adds a both-directions fixture to the existing test-validate-wiring.sh harness, prunes the dangling entries, and redeploys under the full gate set.

artifacts.summary: 4-phase plan with waves 1:[1,3] 2:[2] 3:[4]; Phase 4 declares __WHOLE_TREE__ for the redeploy.
